note: RETIRED 2026-08-23. This file no longer gates anything. It is kept, unmodified below under last_count_baseline, because a retired baseline with its numbers intact is honest and a rewritten one is not.
retired_why: It asserted that no file's count of /\.(ability|baseStats|weighthg|weightkg)\b/ may rise. Measured 2026-08-23: 45.2% of what it counted was not a read at all (prose and writes); a walk of all 130 matches in its last red found ZERO stale-identity reads; 62% of that red was files that did not exist when the baseline was taken. Seven agents had reported it red at six different totals, two of them BELOW the baseline of the day, so the headline actively recommended a restamp; the one wholesale restamp (2026-08-11, 234 -> 1198, 964 reads adopted unreviewed) did not hold a week; and it twice made people reword COMMENTS to hold a number still. It was also GREEN on engine/position_features.js, which contains a real raw read of a live stone-holder. It was measuring the size of the repository, not the risk.
replaced_by: tests/test-effective-identity.js section 3 — a RUNTIME tripwire. Every mon a Board switches in gets a recording accessor on the four transforming fields, every active on the test board holds a mega stone whose forme ability differs from its base, the board is driven through the live decision path, and exactly one call site (board.js effective()) may see the raw field. Its allow-list lives in RUNTIME_ALLOWED in that file, in code, with a written reason per entry and a guard() that re-derives any reason resting on a fact about the format. Its limit is EXECUTION coverage and the drive list is printed on every run.
do_not_restamp: --update and --propose now REFUSE and exit 2. There is nothing here to restamp; adding a file to this list would gate nothing.
